crossRefs.note: The heavens declare the glory of God. The expanse shows his handiwork.
The heavens will praise your wonders, Yahweh, your faithfulness also in the assembly of the holy ones.
Praise Yah! Praise Yahweh from the heavens! Praise him in the heights!
Suddenly, there was with the angel a multitude of the heavenly army praising God, and saying,
“Glory to God in the highest, on earth peace, good will toward men.”
Even so, I tell you, there is joy in the presence of the angels of God over one sinner repenting.”
Yahweh reigns! Let the earth rejoice! Let the multitude of islands be glad!
Make a joyful noise to Yahweh, all the earth! Burst out and sing for joy, yes, sing praises!
The angel said to them, “Don’t be afraid, for behold, I bring you good news of great joy which will be to all the…
Yahweh reigns! He is clothed with majesty! Yahweh is armed with strength. The world also is established. It can’t be…
Your throne is established from long ago. You are from everlasting.
Say among the nations, “Yahweh reigns.” The world is also established. It can’t be moved. He will judge the peoples…
Yahweh reigns! Let the peoples tremble. He sits enthroned among the cherubim. Let the earth be moved.
I will exalt you, my God, the King. I will praise your name forever and ever.
For Yahweh is our judge. Yahweh is our lawgiver. Yahweh is our king. He will save us.
Bring us not into temptation, but deliver us from the evil one. For yours is the Kingdom, the power, and the glory…
I heard something like the voice of a great multitude, and like the voice of many waters, and like the voice of mighty…

parallels.note: Let the heavens be glad, and let the earth rejoice. Let the sea roar, and its fullness!

translations.web: Let the heavens be glad, and let the earth rejoice! Let them say among the nations, “Yahweh reigns!”
translations.bsb: Let the heavens be glad, and the earth rejoice. Let them say among the nations, ‘The LORD reigns!’
translations.kjv: Let the heavens be glad, and let the earth rejoice: and let men say among the nations, The LORD reigneth.
translations.asv: Let the heavens be glad, and let the earth rejoice; And let them say among the nations, Jehovah reigneth.
